introduction: Georgia weatherization services begin with the Community Action Agency serving your county. Eligible homes receive an energy assessment before approved efficiency measures are selected.
description: Georgia weatherization services begin with the Community Action Agency serving your county. Eligible homes receive an energy assessment before approved efficiency measures are

sections.who: The local agency determines whether a low-income household qualifies. Ask about property requirements, any owner consent and the current waiting list.
sections.get: An energy audit examines efficiency and energy-related health or safety conditions. Approved measures follow the assessment; this is not an unrestricted cash payment for repairs.
sections.docs:
• Prepare household income and residence information.
  • Have utility records and ownership or tenancy details available.
  • Get the local agency’s checklist before arranging the assessment.
sections.apply:
1. Identify the county agency

    Use the contact link on GEFA’s weatherization application page.

  2. Request eligibility screening

    Submit the local application and ask whether the agency is accepting new households or maintaining a waiting list.

  3. Arrange the home audit

    If eligible, follow the agency’s inspection instructions and ask what measures are approved.
sections.after: Confirm the planned work and appointments with the provider. Tell it about safety concerns or access limitations before a visit.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using GEFA weatherization application instructions. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can there be a waiting list?
Yes. GEFA warns that high demand can create a waiting list.
Who decides which work is done?
The local program selects measures following the home’s energy audit.
Does weatherization pay my energy bill?
Its focus is selected efficiency services. Ask the local agency separately about bill assistance.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
